meta.title: QuiTwin - Keep Equicord installed through Discord updates
meta.description: QuiTwin installs Equicord once and keeps it working through Discord updates on Windows. No service, scheduled task, or repeat patching.
meta.ogAlt: QuiTwin keeps Equicord installed through Discord updates

a11y.logoAlt: QuiTwin interlocking Q mark in violet and cyan

hero.title: Discord updates. Equicord stays.
hero.copy: QuiTwin installs Discord when needed, adds Equicord, and keeps it attached across updates. No background service or repeat patching.
hero.after: Run it once. The installer removes itself when setup succeeds.
